snippet.title: Diecast: Deckbuilding Dicey Roguelike | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam NOW! demo out early August.

Welcome to a dicey roguelike! Roll, buy, and sell a plethora of wild dice, scoring hands, and items to tip the scales of Lady Luck in your favor. Find unique dice that fit your build and unleash powerful synergies to dominate each roll.
